title: Skill drawer — what this project can use

steps.headline: Should the drawer show Automatic, Manual use, and Unavailable like this?
steps.changed: The skill cards gain a quiet availability label beside their existing source badge. An unavailable skill stays visible as a muted non-clickable card, with a note that its choice is saved but the file is missing here. Two short lines above the cards explain automatic use and how to invoke manual skills with /.
steps.notice: Manual use still opens the skill deliberately; turning off automatic use does not hide it from / or the drawer. Missing items cannot be run from the drawer.
steps.risk: These are workbench sample statuses, not real project settings; the missing-card action is only copy, not navigation.

steps.headline: Do the same labels stay readable when the drawer is narrow?
steps.changed: At 390px the drawer keeps its existing two-column cards. Scrolling reveals the skill status beside the plugin badge; the unavailable card uses the same grid without offering a false Run action.
steps.notice: Search and favorites remain where they are today.
steps.risk: The sample status labels are not yet wired to project availability.
